addictionPotential: 极易成瘾且具有高滥用潜力。
toxicities: 估计人体口服 LD50 为 6.5-13 mg/kg。
summary: 一种存在于烟草、茄子与番茄中的化学物质，被认为是最具成瘾性的药物之一。属温和兴奋剂，有减压效果。常以香烟形式使用，长期使用有较高致癌或心脏问题风险。越来越多地以“电子烟”方式使用，被认为比吸烟更安全。
effectsSummary: Stimulating, increases alertness and concentration, reduces appetite, relaxing effect, mild euphoria.
dosageRemark: [TBT] Individual and dependent on the form of consumption. The lethal dose of nicotine for adults is about 60 mg; for children and adolescents it is significantly lower.
generalRisks: Highly addictive. Increases heart rate and blood pressure. Long-term use causes cardiovascular disease, lung cancer (when smoked), and reproductive issues.
longtermRisks: Long-term use dramatically increases risk of lung cancer (smoked), COPD, cardiovascular disease, stroke, and premature aging.
saferUse: Use nicotine replacement therapy for cessation.
Avoid smoking - consider vaping or patches.
Be aware of the addictive potential.

tolerance.full: [TBT] rapidly develops with prolonged and repeated use
